overall.normal: Keep checking the tank. Follow any sensor warning shown in the app.
overall.verify: Check the readings and sensors. If available, compare the readings with another meter. Follow any sensor warning shown in the app. Do not treat or change the water based only on this result.

DO.decreasing: Check the dissolved oxygen (DO) reading and sensor. Make sure the aerator is running and water is moving. Follow any low-oxygen warning shown in the app.
DO.increasing: Check the dissolved oxygen (DO) reading and keep monitoring it. Follow any oxygen warning shown in the app.
DO.stable: Check the dissolved oxygen (DO) reading and sensor. Make sure the aerator is running and water is moving. Follow any oxygen warning shown in the app.
DO.verify: Check the dissolved oxygen (DO) reading and sensor, and make sure the aerator is running. Follow any oxygen warning shown in the app.

turbidity.increasing: Check the water-clarity (turbidity) reading and sensor. Make sure the sensor is clean and in place. Look at the water and check the filter. Follow any water-clarity warning shown in the app.
turbidity.decreasing: Check the water-clarity (turbidity) reading and sensor. Review recent cleaning, filtering, or water changes. Follow any water-clarity warning shown in the app.
turbidity.stable: Check the water-clarity (turbidity) reading and sensor. Make sure the sensor is clean and in place. Look at the water and check the filter.
turbidity.verify: Check the water-clarity reading, sensor, and filter. Follow any water-clarity warning shown in the app.

pH.increasing: Check the pH with a calibrated meter and inspect the sensor. Follow any pH warning shown in the app. Do not add chemicals based only on this result.
pH.decreasing: Check the pH with a calibrated meter and inspect the sensor. Follow any pH warning shown in the app. Do not add chemicals based only on this result.
pH.stable: Check the pH with a calibrated meter and inspect the sensor. Follow any pH warning shown in the app. Do not add chemicals based only on this result.
pH.verify: Check the pH with a calibrated meter and inspect the sensor. Follow any pH warning shown in the app. Do not add chemicals based only on this result.

temp.increasing: Check the temperature with a thermometer. Look for recent heat or water changes, and check the DO reading too. Follow any temperature or DO warning shown in the app.
temp.decreasing: Check the temperature with a thermometer. Review recent weather and water changes. Follow any temperature warning shown in the app.
temp.stable: Check the temperature with a thermometer. Follow any temperature warning shown in the app.
temp.verify: Check the temperature with a thermometer and review recent weather or water changes. Follow any temperature warning shown in the app.

combined_do_turbidity.action: Check the dissolved oxygen and water-clarity readings and sensors. Make sure the aerator and filter are working and water is moving. Follow any oxygen or water-clarity warning shown in the app.

combined_temp_do.action: Check the temperature and dissolved oxygen readings. Look for heat or water changes, and make sure the aerator is running. Follow any temperature or oxygen warning shown in the app.

combined_ph_do.action: Check the pH and dissolved oxygen readings and keep monitoring them. Follow any pH or oxygen warning shown in the app. Do not add chemicals based only on this result.

redclaw_qld.title: Business Queensland: Redclaw crayfish aquaculture
redclaw_qld.scope: Species-specific context for Cherax quadricarinatus, primarily in earthen ponds; do not transfer its numeric guidance to another species or tank without local validation.

ras_qld.title: Business Queensland: Recirculating aquaculture systems
ras_qld.scope: General recirculating-aquaculture system and filtration context; inspect the installed system rather than infer failure from a sensor pattern.

usgs_do.title: U.S. Geological Survey: Dissolved Oxygen and Water
usgs_do.scope: Temperature affects oxygen solubility; photosynthesis and decomposition can influence dissolved oxygen.

usgs_turbidity.title: U.S. Geological Survey: Turbidity and Water
usgs_turbidity.scope: Turbidity is affected by suspended inorganic and organic matter, algae, and plankton; it does not identify a specific cause.

monitoring_usgs.title: Wagner et al. (2006), Guidelines and standard procedures for continuous water-quality monitors
monitoring_usgs.scope: Quality assurance, calibration, fouling checks, and maintenance for continuous water-quality monitoring.

buffering_msu.title: Mississippi State University Extension: pH and Alkalinity
buffering_msu.scope: Alkalinity buffers pH; pond pH can vary with biological activity and time of day. Fish-pond advice is general context, not a crayfish-tank treatment prescription.

ufifas_aeration.title: UF/IFAS Extension: The Role of Aeration in Pond Management
ufifas_aeration.scope: Pond aeration and water mixing can support dissolved oxygen management; practices must suit the actual production system.

ufifas_do.title: UF/IFAS Extension: Dissolved Oxygen for Fish Production
ufifas_do.scope: Aquaculture pond DO cycles and oxygen demand from excess feed and decaying organic matter; species-specific limits still apply.
